from dataclasses import replace
    targets={f'{op} {w}0, {w}1, #{immediate}'
             for w in ['w','x']
             for op,immediate in [('add','127'),('sub','127'),('and','0xff'),('orr','0xff'),('eor','0xff')]}
    selected,bindings,found=[],[],set()
    for assembly,e,special,body,decoded in pairs:
        if assembly not in targets:
            continue
        found.add(assembly)
        assert e.op=='ARM64_OP_ALU_IMM'
        for token in ['ARM64_OP_ADD_IMM','ARM64_OP_SUB_IMM','ARM64_OP_ALU_IMM']:
            forced=replace(e,op=token)
            for route in ['raw','direct']:
                entry='ARM64_SIM_RUN_OP3' if route=='raw' else 'ARM64_SIM_RUN_KNOWN_OP3'
                statement=(f'{entry}({forced.op}, {forced.dst}, {forced.src}, '
                           f'{forced.src2}, {forced.src3}, {forced.width}, {forced.aux}, {forced.imm})')
                label=f'{assembly} [token={forced.op}; route={route}]'
                selected.append((label,forced,statement,body,decoded))
                bindings.append(dict(assembly=assembly,route=route,original=e.__dict__,bound=forced.__dict__))
    assert found==targets and len(selected)==60
    pairs=selected
    (out/'numeric-bindings.json').write_text(json.dumps(bindings,indent=2)+'\n')
